name: com.superstables/superstables
title: Superstables
description: Find services, request single purchases and read budgets.

tools.name: get_my_account
tools.description: The Superstables account connected to this chat: id, nullable name, active wallets (oldest first), client_name, registration and scopes. address and namespace identify the first wallet, or are both null if none. Namespace is eip155 for Ethereum or solana for Solana. Moves no funds.

tools.name: find_services
tools.description: Search the services this chat can buy through Superstables: each one's id, what it returns, its price, the chain it is paid on, whether that chain is a testnet, and its inputs. A service with testnet false is paid on a mainnet. q matches words in the id, name and description; chain is a chain key or CAIP-2 id, such as arc, base-sepolia or eip155:5042, and an unknown chain is refused. Index listings come 20 at a time: for more, repeat the call with the same q and chain and next_cursor as cursor. Reads a public catalogue and moves no funds.

q.description: Words to look for, such as "market data"

chain.description: A chain key or CAIP-2 id, such as "base-sepolia", "arc" or "eip155:5042"

tools.name: request_purchase
tools.description: Requests approval to buy one service from find_services. Returns an approval link and match code. Any account member may review and sign the payment in a wallet on superstables.com; nothing is paid until then. Use a new operation_id for each purchase. Within this connection, retrying that ID returns the request while it is kept, without creating another. Revoking and reconnecting starts a new connection.

service_id.description: The id of a service from find_services

params.description: The service's inputs by name, as find_services lists them

max_amount.description: The most to pay, in the service's token, such as "0.01"; refused above it

operation_id.description: New for each purchase, the same for a retry of it

recovery.description: Optional. Can only narrow what the account allows for Auto Recovery: rail false means never offer another chain for this request; max_attempts 1 to 3; allowed_networks lists chain ids. It cannot turn anything on.

tools.name: get_purchase_status
tools.description: Reads a purchase this chat asked for: whether the owner approved it, whether it was paid, the service's answer and the receipt. Show the owner the approval link and match code before calling this tool. Then keep calling it with wait_seconds 25 in the same turn while the result says to keep waiting. It also works when called later. A payment whose outcome is not known yet is reported as unknown, never as unpaid.

wait_seconds.description: Hold the answer up to this many seconds until the purchase is final. Use 25 while the owner has not approved yet.

tools.name: list_my_purchases
tools.description: Lists up to 50 recent purchase requests from this connection, newest first. Call get_purchase_status with a purchase_id for its current status and result.

tools.name: cancel_purchase
tools.description: Cancel a purchase request from this connection while it is waiting for approval. If payment may have been sent, the outcome is unknown; call get_purchase_status.

tools.name: list_my_budgets
tools.description: The agents linked to this Superstables account and their budgets: each agent's id, label, chain, budget, what is left to spend, what it has used (null when not counted), its gas balance and the state of its budget. Reads the chain now and moves no funds.

tools.name: get_budget_request
tools.description: Reads one budget approval from the approval link the Superstables CLI printed: its kind, state, whether it is final, its steps and their transaction hashes. Pass the whole link. It doesn't return the link's token and moves no funds.

approval_link.description: The approval link the CLI printed, as printed

tools.name: request_budget_revoke
tools.description: Gives the owner the link to revoke an agent's budget, for an agent from list_my_budgets. The owner signs the revoke with their wallet on superstables.com. This tool signs and sends nothing and does not revoke the budget.

agent.description: The id of an agent from list_my_budgets

tools.name: remove_budget_agent
tools.description: Removes an agent from this account, off chain, once Superstables confirms it has no spending permission. A live Tempo key must be revoked even if its current budget is spent. Moves no funds.

agent.description: The id of an agent from list_my_budgets

tools.name: submit_budget_request
tools.description: Only for a coding agent on the owner's machine, such as Claude Code or Codex, sending a block that its own Superstables CLI signed and whose agent key and records stay on that machine. A chat app is refused: never ask the owner to paste a signed block into a chat. Without such a block, don't call this tool or build the block yourself. Sends a budget request that the CLI signed with --sign-only to superstables.com for the owner's approval. Pass the CLI's JSON block unchanged: method, path, headers and body. Superstables checks the agent's signature over that exact request, so it can't be changed here, and refuses a request sent twice or after its time window. A request to add an agent must use owner proof version 2. Returns the request id, the owner's approval link, the match code, when the link expires and the wallets of the account the request is on. Nothing changes until the owner approves with their wallet on superstables.com.

headers.description: The four agent proof headers, as the CLI printed them

body.description: The request body exactly as the CLI printed it; any change fails the signature

tools.name: find_budget_services
tools.description: Lists the services a budget can pay: each one's name, URL, price, chain and whether its output is sample data. With once, lists what Single purchase on superstables.com can buy instead. chain narrows the list to one chain, such as base-sepolia. Where this site offers them, it adds up to 20 listings from the Superstables index; q keeps those whose id, name and description contain its words. A price is what the seller asked for last and may have changed. Reads a list and moves no funds.

chain.description: A chain key, such as "base-sepolia", "moderato" or "devnet"

once.description: True for the services Single purchase on superstables.com can buy, without a budget

q.description: Words to look for in the index, such as "exchange rates"

tools.name: preflight_budget_purchase
tools.description: Gives the price, recipient and chain find_budget_services lists for one of its services, and when that price was last checked. With agent, also says whether what is left of that agent's budget covers it. This is the listed price, not a live one: the Superstables CLI's budget buy reads the seller's live price and recipient, and checks them, before it pays. Any other URL is refused. Doesn't contact the seller, sign transactions or move funds.

url.description: A service URL exactly as find_budget_services lists it

agent.description: The id of an agent from list_my_budgets; its chain is the one checked

chain.description: A chain key, when the URL is listed on more than one chain

tools.name: wait_budget_request
tools.description: Follows one budget approval until it is final or wait_seconds pass (at most 25). Pass the approval link the Superstables CLI printed, or the request_id submit_budget_request returned for this account. Returns what get_budget_request returns. A request awaiting the owner doesn't establish whether the owner has approved it, a transaction in a block is not final until the chain says so, and an unknown outcome is not a failure. Moves no funds.

approval_link.description: The approval link the CLI printed, as printed

wait_seconds.description: Hold the answer up to this many seconds until the request is final. Use 25 while it is not.

tools.name: get_budget_status
tools.description: One agent's budget as list_my_budgets shows it, read from the chain now, with the owner's last action for it (setup, grant, revoke or fund) and whether that is final. revoke says whether the latest revoke on record is final, in a block but not final yet, or unknown. Treat a revoke as done, and a new grant as usable, only once it is final. Moves no funds.

agent.description: The id of an agent from list_my_budgets
